record.original_question: Zavorotnyi proved that the fourth moment I2(T) of the Riemann zeta function has the asymptotic I2(T) = T P4(log T) + O(T^(2/3 + epsilon)), where P4 is a specific polynomial of degree 4. Improve the exponent in this error term.

evidence.quote: In 1989 Zavorotnyi proved that I2 (T ) = T P4 (log T ) + O(T^(2/3 + epsilon)), where P4 is a specific degree 4 polynomial. Improve the bound in the error term.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For $T \geq 2$, let
$$I_2(T) = \int_0^T \left|\zeta\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2} + it\right)\right|^4 dt,$$
where $\zeta$ denotes the Riemann zeta function. It is known that there exists an explicit polynomial $P_4$ of degree $4$ (with coefficients depending only on absolute constants) such that, for every $\varepsilon > 0$,
$$I_2(T) = T\, P_4(\log T) + O\!\left(T^{2/3 + \varepsilon}\right).$$
Improve the exponent in the error term: that is, establish an asymptotic of the form
$$I_2(T) = T\, P_4(\log T) + O\!\left(T^{\theta + \varepsilon}\right)$$
for some constant $\theta < 2/3$, or determine the infimum of admissible exponents $\theta$.
artifact.category_tag: Moments of the Riemann zeta function
artifact.status_search_result: The $T^{2/3+\varepsilon}$ bound for the error term in the fourth moment of $\zeta(1/2+it)$ remains the state of the art. Ivić and others have made only logarithmic refinements (e.g., recent 2025 work establishes $E_2(2T) - E_2(T) \ll T^{2/3}(\log T)^{3.5}/(\log\log T)^C$), but no power-saving improvement below $2/3$ is known. The problem of improving the exponent is widely regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: On the error term of the fourth moment of the Riemann zeta-function
status_evidence.snippet: Makes improvements in the powers of log T in the known bounds for E_2(T); E_2(2T)-E_2(T) << T^{2/3} (log T)^{3.5}/(log log T)^C.
status_evidence.claim: Only logarithmic refinements to the T^{2/3} exponent are available; the power exponent has not been improved.

status_evidence.title: On the Error Term for the Fourth Moment of the Riemann Zeta-Function (Ivić, 1999)
status_evidence.snippet: Study of the error term E_2(T) in the asymptotic for the fourth moment with the T^{2/3+epsilon} bound as the benchmark.
status_evidence.claim: The T^{2/3+epsilon} bound from Zavorotnyi remains the benchmark exponent.
